product.olivetti-m386-25.summary: A high-end workstation with 32 KB cache and integrated video.
product.olivetti-m386-25.history: The September 1991 professional catalogue listed M386/25 (a high-end workstation with 32 KB cache and integrated video).
product.olivetti-m386-25.architecture: The board determines which peripheral combination needs verification. The guide identifies BA247 / BA255 / BA263 · 82C452 · AT.
product.olivetti-m386-25.firmware: The BIOS revision helps identify the service configuration. The guide records 1.09 · PEQS (L, U65) / PEQR (H, U66).
product.olivetti-m386-25.verified: The identity was checked in Olivetti documentation. The sheet remains under research.
product.olivetti-m386-25.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-m386-25.guide: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, 14-1.
product.olivetti-m386-25.market: Olivetti, La gamma dei personal computer professionali, 3905621C-00, 9/91.
